data.label: Common Mistakes
data.title:
5 website mistakes
*costing you calls*
data.sub: Swipe to see if you're losing money →

data.label: Tip #1
data.title: No *phone number* on top
data.body: If customers can't find your number in seconds, they will leave. You want to make it effortless for them to book your services.
data.fix: Fix: Add your phone number to the top right corner header.

data.label: Tip #2
data.title: Website isn't *mobile friendly*
data.body: Most people search for local services on their phones. If your site looks tiny or broken, they will call a competitor instead.
data.fix: Fix: Test your site on a phone and fix layout issues.

data.label: Tip #3
data.title: Site takes *too long* to load
data.body: Slow websites frustrate visitors immediately. If your page doesn't load in three seconds, most potential customers will just click away.
data.fix: Fix: Compress your high-resolution images to smaller file sizes.

data.label: Tip #4
data.title: No clear *call to action*
data.body: Don't make customers guess what to do next. Tell them exactly how to hire you with a simple, obvious button.
data.fix: Fix: Add a 'Call Now' button to every single page.

data.label: Tip #5
data.title: Missing *service area* details
data.body: Customers need to know if you actually serve their neighborhood. Without this, they won't waste time calling to ask.
data.fix: Fix: Clearly list your service cities on your home page.
